title: Contract field table
responsibility: Display contract types, input requirements, literal defaults and examples with accessible detail controls.

inputs.name: ContractTable.group
inputs.description: Named parameter, return or component fields with types and authored or illustrative examples.

inputs.name: ContractTable.plain
inputs.description: Optional compact labels beneath a callable heading.

inputs.name: ContractTable.onexample
inputs.description: Open the existing example modal and retain its focus return target.

outputs.name: ContractTable
outputs.description: A typed table with input Requirement and Default columns. Provenance labels stay readable while long example data is clipped; tablet and mobile stack cells and retain keyboard-accessible detail controls.

errors.name: onexample callback error
errors.description: An error from the example callback propagates when a field's example button is activated.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: A literal default contains BigInt or circular data that JSON cannot serialize.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Deeply nested literal defaults exceed the JSON serializer stack.

errors.name: Getter, proxy or conversion error
errors.description: Errors from supplied field/default/example getters, proxy traps or JSON conversion methods propagate.
